meta.purpose: search_web LLM self-diagnosis experiment integration for future method selection
meta.created_from: existing experiment artifacts only; no new runs
meta.note: Unknown fields use unknown or not_recorded. Do not treat hypotheses as measured results.

experiments.name: data_only_llm_diagnosis
input_conditions: no full code pack by design
compared: llm independent analysis without prior conclusions in prompt
supported_claims: data-only diagnosis motivates need for code reading
failed_claims: reliable path attribution from data alone

experiments.name: diagnostic_framework_self_verify
input_conditions: code_pack missing reported in early full run
supported_claims: harness ctx and code attachment dominate diagnosis quality
failed_claims: missing-code conclusion always reflects production code absence

experiments.name: code_reading_experiment
compared: code only vs code+logs vs cause diagnosis
supported_claims: entry backends and rank_hits_for_query often found
path connection and cause overconfidence remain failure modes
failed_claims: sufficient code alone yields correct stdout vs LLM handoff attribution

experiments.name: spec_experiment_v1
input_conditions: optional design-map spec without answer line leakage intent
supported_claims: spec alone insufficient for implementation attribution
failed_claims: spec resolves stdout L520 vs dumps confusion

experiments.name: spec_experiment_v2
compared: no-spec vs spec v1 vs spec v2
supported_claims: spec refinement alone does not clearly beat baselines on critical handoff items
failed_claims: existence/usage principles eliminate mis-attribution on critical items

experiments.name: route_decomposition_experiment
input_conditions: monolithic pack vs decomposed route packs
compared: bulk vs spec+bulk vs decomposed vs decomposed+logs
supported_claims: separating display and LLM packs can improve connection tests
failed_claims: decomposition alone removes caller errors and cause overconfidence

experiments.name: ranking_filter_log_evidence_experiment
supported_claims: FACT/OBSERVED/INFERENCE/UNKNOWN reduces invented OBSERVED without logs
split packs help stage attribution conditionally
failed_claims: evidence labels alone guarantee correct causes

experiments.name: n2_execution_path_gate
compared: no gate vs N2 vs N2+full path story
supported_claims: N2 is for off-path filtering only
on-path wrong causation not removed by N2
full path narrative can increase overconfidence
failed_claims: N2 measures cause strength or occurrence

experiments.name: model_comparison_deepseek
compared: qwen3:8b reused artifacts vs deepseek new runs
supported_claims: model swap alone does not fix shared failure modes
context limits are part of DeepSeek comparison outcome
failed_claims: replacing diagnostic LLM with DeepSeek is sufficient

experiments.name: large_llm_search_web_diagnosis
input_conditions: condition B: code+logs without qwen conclusions
condition A: audit of existing qwen results
compared: qwen3:8b prior results vs large llm independent diagnosis
supported_claims: better path separation false-cause rejection and UNKNOWN use than qwen on this set
failed_claims: large llm alone proves general self-diagnosis or safe auto-fix
